import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first = nn.Linear(4, 4)
        self.last = nn.Linear(4, 2)
    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.first(x)
        h = F.gelu(input=h)
        a = h + 1
        b = a + a
        return self.last(b)
